cards.name: Lydari Druid
cards.oracleText: When Lydari Druid enters, for each land on the battlefield, choose a basic land type at random. Those lands become the land types chosen this way. (This effect lasts indefinitely.)

cards.name: Lydari Elephant
cards.oracleText: As Lydari Elephant enters, choose two numbers from 3 to 7 at random. Lydari Elephant's power is equal to the first number chosen and its toughness equal to the second number chosen.
